1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically for filing proofs of claims in bankruptcy proceedings;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include proof of claim forms with supporting documentation specific to each creditor's claim;
and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein batch filing includes aggregating the proofs of claims and filing them in batch mode at least once per day.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises validating the data records prior to generating the bankruptcy documents.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim and wherein the requests are received via a secure file transfer protocol or through a Web site;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include proof of claim forms with supporting documentation;
validating the data records prior to generating the proofs of claims;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in batch mode at least once per day.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the batch filing is performed by a server computer.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy and include information regarding the status of filed proofs of claims.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol and validating the authenticity of the requests prior to processing.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site and storing the requests in a centralized database before batch processing.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, with the aggregation performed on a creditor-by-creditor basis.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor showing the status of their filed proofs of claims;
and
sending the report to a particular creditor via a Web site or electronic transmission.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site and providing real-time access to filing status information.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed and identifying any validation errors or missing documentation.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim and transmitting the filing receipt to the creditor.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer, and wherein the server computer maintains separate filing protocols for each different bankruptcy organization.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record prior to automatically generating the proofs of claims, wherein validation includes verifying required fields and checking for formatting compliance with each bankruptcy organization's requirements.
